scope: Classical high-speed CAN linear bus; ideal terminated differential transmission-line model

claims.claim: Two 120-ohm resistors are normally placed across CAN_H/CAN_L at opposite physical ends of the main trunk
claims.locator: Physical endpoint termination in reference design

claims.claim: Two identical 120-ohm resistors in parallel have an ideal 60-ohm DC equivalent
Ideal voltage reflection coefficient is (R_L-Z0)/(R_L+Z0); zero when R_L matches Z0
Split termination can substitute two series resistors with a midpoint capacitance for a 120-ohm equivalent
claims.locator: standard vs split termination application comparison

claims.claim: Under a specified 2V differential assumption, each 120-ohm resistor dissipates about 0.033 W
claims.notes: Not a resistor power-rating design rule; transients/faults excluded.

claims.claim: About 60-ohm powered-off reading cannot by itself verify endpoint placement or wave quality
